title: Thai-Style Oatmeal Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious breakfast pilaf, inspired by Thai cuisine. This dish combines the comforting warmth of oatmeal with the aromatic spices of Thailand.
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the jdecadent over medium heat.
Add the pilaf and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the oatmeal, water, and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the zesty and lemon juice.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed and the pilaf is tender.
